Xelvin is looking for a technically strong Naval Architect who wants to relocate to the Netherlands and work on high-end custom-built superyachts. For an innovative high-tech company in the Tilburg region, we are looking for a Module Assembly Operator. In this role, you will work on high-quality modules where precision, craftsmanship, and quality are central within a technically advanced production environment where complex three-dimensional modules are assembled, welded, and tested according to strict quality standards.

As a Module Assembly Operator, you will be responsible for assembling and welding complex modules. You will work based on technical drawings and execute work orders according to planning. Besides the assembly and welding activities, you will carry out repair work and contribute to pilot projects and the development of new products. You will digitally register completed work orders in the system and support colleagues by sharing knowledge and providing instructions when needed.

Within this role, you are also expected to actively contribute ideas for improving processes and working methods.
